articles.title: The biggest consensus overhaul in Solana history is officially live for testing
articles.snippet: The upgrade, known as Alpenglow, is live on a community test cluster, said Solana core developer Anza.

articles.title: Tom Lee's Bitmine slows down ether purchases after already buying 1 million tokens this year
articles.snippet: The firm bought roughly 26,000 ether last week, a sharp decline from the average of the previous weeks' 100,000.

articles.title: Bitcoin whipsaws on CME open as Iran tensions pressure crypto markets
articles.snippet: BTC briefly topped $82,400 before slipping below $81,000 as traders repositioned around CME futures open and geopolitical risks rattled markets.

articles.title: Policy at Consensus Miami: State of Crypto
Agentic commerce will run on crypto rails, PayPal and Google reps tell Consensus Miami
articles.snippet: Senior figures from PayPal and Google Cloud said open payment protocols, machine-readable merchant catalogs and multi-party crypto custody are needed to scale agentic commerce.
